description: This file defines the 'FeaturePropertiesCreated' event class used within the Eclipse Ditto project, representing an event emitted after a Feature's properties are created, including methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, comparison, and construction.

classes.name: FeaturePropertiesCreated
classes.description: An immutable event class representing the creation of feature properties, capable of serialization/deserialization, comparison, and building JSON representations, used in the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of FeaturePropertiesCreated with specified parameters, including optional timestamp and metadata.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static method to deserialize a FeaturePropertiesCreated object from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature associated with the created properties.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns the FeatureProperties object encapsulated by this event.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Creates a new instance with an updated revision number.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new instance with updated Ditto headers.
